cohort: The study included 147,950 pregnant women aged 20-45 years, comparing outcomes between those with (n=11,400) and without (n=136,550) endometriosis, using nationwide population-based data.
finding: Endometriosis is an independent risk factor for several pregnancy complications, including miscarriage, preterm birth, premature rupture of membranes, placenta previa, and urinary tract infections.
mod_finding: Women with endometriosis had an increased risk of caesarean section (aRR 1.13, 95% CI 1.11-1.16).
